purpose: Create a native Idle UL back view of the approved five-red chow poet carrying one approved fully sheathed ring-pommel Tang dao in a relaxed pose, with truthful behind-body occlusion.
identityInvariants: same chow breed and orange five-red palette
same compact rounded capsule core as approved DR anchor
two triangular ears and one full fluffy tail
native upper-left back view with no facial features
four compact paws directly attached to core
shapeStrategy: Natively redraw the poet from the upper-left back view. Draw both front paws and the single fully sheathed Tang dao behind the capsule core first, then cover their inner portions with the core. At the shoulder expose only a small oblique edge-on ring, a short connected grip, and optionally one connected scabbard-throat cue. The remaining sheath may be completely hidden.
colorStrategy: Preserve approved poet and Tang dao colors; keep flat restrained back lighting and do not place eyes, nose, mouth, muzzle, or facial blaze on the back.
materialStrategy: Keep actor and dao in the same bold-outline, low-detail, flat-value Pure Run language.
allowedVariation: native back-view redraw of head body markings tail and feet
small outer arcs of both front paws
complete occlusion of most or all scabbard below the shoulder
one connected shoulder-side ring grip and throat cue
forbidden: eyes nose mouth or muzzle on back view
visible arm forearm leg lower-leg or thin paw connector
